transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling really down and depressed lately, and it just doesn't seem to lift. This constant cloud of sadness has been hanging over me for about 11 months now.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I'm really not sure, to be honest. I can't think of any specific stressful event or big life change that triggered it. It just seemed to build up on its own, and it's been going on like this for about 11 months now.
Before these past 11 months, had you been feeling down most days for at least 2 years, or is this the first time it has lasted this long?
I haven't experienced this kind of prolonged low mood before these past 11 months. This is definitely the first time it has ever lasted this long.
Along with feeling depressed, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I really have. I've completely lost interest in the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy, and they just don't appeal to me anymore. Even when I try to do them, I don't feel any joy or pleasure from them at all.
How has your sleep been during this time—are you sleeping much more or less than usual, or having trouble falling or staying asleep?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep patterns. It has been relatively normal, and I don't seem to be sleeping much more or less than usual.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight during this time?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my weight. Everything has stayed pretty much the same as usual.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy nearly every day during this time?
No, I haven't really noticed feeling unusually tired or low on energy. That hasn't been a prominent issue for me during this time.
Have you been feeling worthless, excessively guilty, or very hard on yourself nearly every day during this time?
No, I haven't really been feeling worthless or excessively guilty. I don't tend to be overly hard on myself in that way.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, thinking clearly, or making decisions during this time?

Yes, I've really been struggling with all of that. My mind constantly feels foggy and dazed, which makes it very hard to focus on simple tasks like reading or watching TV. I also find it incredibly difficult to make even minor, everyday decisions.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. I also haven't felt like life isn't worth living, even though I've been feeling so down.
